paper_id: Towards Neural Speaker Modeling in Multi-Party Conversation_ The Task, Dataset, and Models
title: Towards Neural Speaker Modeling in Multi-Party Conversation: The Task, Dataset, and Models
motivation: Neural dialog systems lack established tasks and datasets for speaker modeling; prior work requires massive per-speaker data or explicit mentions
problem_framing: 提出speaker classification作为speaker modeling的代理任务,用softmax式匹配预测当前 utterance 的说话人
key_insight: content信息与temporal信息互补;简单线性插值后训练效果优于复杂门控机制,因为端到端训练带来优化困难
method_signature: 层次RNN编码utterance,结合speaker内容向量与位置embedding,通过插值或门控融合两路预测
evaluation_criteria: 数据集严重倾斜,accuracy被majority class主导,选用macro F1作为主要指标以覆盖少数类
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: self-adaptive gating未超越简单插值;注意力机制带来提升极小;端到端混合训练导致优化困难
evidence_for_taste: surrogate task for general speaker modeling
simple interpolation is surprisingly more efficient
g is sensitive and only yields high performance
thinking_moves: 把speaker modeling问题重新frame成speaker classification分类任务,类比NUC作为dialog generation的代理任务
注意到数据集类别倾斜,主动选择macro F1而非accuracy作为主要指标
观察到content与temporal捕获不同证据,提出hybrid融合而非单一模型
对复杂门控机制持保留态度,优先尝试简单插值并验证其有效性
cites_own_work: Meng et al. 2017 (hierarchical RNN with static sentence-level attention)
